# Tabs

<!-- Generated by `pnpm readme:build`. Edit only inside the hand-written block. -->

navigation and disclosure · tier 1 · beta · renders on the server, with only its interactive part in the browser.

<!-- hand-written -->

## When to use

For two or more views of one thing, shown one at a time: a project's overview, its activity
and its settings. Every panel is in the HTML the server sends, the hidden ones too.

```ts
import { TabsList, TabsPanel, TabsRoot, TabsTab } from 'topclassui/tabs'
```

```tsx
<TabsRoot defaultValue="overview">
  <TabsList aria-label="Project">
    <TabsTab value="overview">Overview</TabsTab>
    <TabsTab value="activity">Activity</TabsTab>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsPanel value="overview">Revenue is up 12% against last quarter.</TabsPanel>
  <TabsPanel value="activity">Three people edited this project today.</TabsPanel>
</TabsRoot>
```

- **Parts.** Four flat names and no bare `Tabs`: `TabsRoot`, `TabsList`, `TabsTab` and
  `TabsPanel`. Each passes the rest of its props to the element it draws.
- **A name.** `TabsList` needs `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. TypeScript refuses it
  without one.
- **`defaultValue`.** Always pass it, or `value`. Without it the server HTML shows no panel
  until the page hydrates.
- **On the server.** Write a panel's content in your Server Component. All panels are in
  the HTML; the ones not open are `hidden`.
- **A heavy panel.** `keepMounted={false}` on a `TabsPanel` leaves it out until its tab is
  opened.
- **Looks.** `variant` on `TabsRoot`: `line` (a bar under the active tab) or `enclosed`
  (the active tab raised inside a tinted box).
- **Size.** `size` on `TabsRoot` sets every tab. `custom` sets nothing: give each
  `TabsTab` its own `className`.
- **Many tabs.** The list scrolls sideways inside itself, and the page does not. An arrow
  key brings the next tab into view.
- **A long label.** It ends in an ellipsis at the width of the list, and is cut at 100
  characters.
- **Keyboard.** The arrow keys move along the tabs, Home and End go to the first and the
  last, and Enter or Space opens the tab. Tab then moves to the panel.
- **Arabic.** The arrow keys follow `TopClassProvider`: with `direction="rtl"` the left
  arrow goes to the next tab. Without a provider they stay left to right.
- **Disabled.** `disabled` on a `TabsTab`. It cannot be opened; the arrow keys still stop
  on it, so a screen reader hears that it is there.
- **A panel that starts with a control.** The panel is a tab stop of its own. Pass
  `tabIndex={-1}` to a `TabsPanel` whose first thing is a button or a field.
- **From a server page.** Pass text, booleans and elements. `value` with `onValueChange`
  needs a `'use client'` file: see `dummy/controlled.tsx`.

### What Base UI gives

| Prop | On | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `value`, `defaultValue`, `onValueChange` | `TabsRoot` | Which tab is open, yours or its own. |
| `orientation` | `TabsRoot` | `vertical` moves the arrow keys to up and down. The look stays a row. |
| `activateOnFocus` | `TabsList` | An arrow key opens the tab it lands on. |
| `loopFocus` | `TabsList` | `false` stops the arrow keys at the first and the last tab. |
| `disabled` | `TabsTab` | The tab cannot be opened. |
| `render`, `nativeButton` | `TabsTab` | Another element than a button. |
| `keepMounted` | `TabsPanel` | Ours is `true` by default, where Base UI's is `false`. |

### Not built

A sliding indicator (Base UI's `Tabs.Indicator`), a vertical look, `fullWidth`, a hover
style, scroll buttons at the ends of a long list, and a `Tabs` built from data.

<!-- /hand-written -->

## Import

```tsx
import {
  TabsRoot,
  TabsList,
  TabsPanel,
  TabsTab,
} from 'topclassui/tabs'
```

## Props

Required: `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` on `TabsList`. Every other prop below is optional.

### TabsRoot

| Prop | Required | Type | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | no | `xs` \| `sm` \| `md` \| `lg` \| `xl` \| `custom` | `"md"` | TabsRoot: the height, padding and type step of every tab; custom emits none. |
| `variant` | no | `line` \| `enclosed` | `"line"` | TabsRoot: line underlines the active tab, enclosed lifts it onto a raised surface. |

### TabsList

| Prop | Required | Type | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aria-label` | **yes**, or `aria-labelledby` | `string` | - | The name read out when no visible text names the group. |
| `aria-labelledby` | **yes**, or `aria-label` | `string` | - | The id of the visible text that names the group. |

### TabsPanel

| Prop | Required | Type | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `keepMounted` | no | `boolean` | `true` | TabsPanel: whether a panel that is not active stays in the HTML, hidden. |

### TabsTab

This part takes no design props of its own.

Anything else is passed to the element each part draws, so standard attributes (`onClick`, `aria-*`, `data-*`, `id`) work. `className` is merged last, so yours wins a conflict, and `ref` is a normal prop.
